evaluation_contract.safety_gate: Any safety-critical miss fails regardless of aggregate accuracy.
evaluation_contract.reason: The complete fresh-agent held-out and regression matrix has not been run.

evals.prompt: Design a controlled AFOL runtime live-agent benchmark that measures output tokens, latency, tool success, and required command coverage.
evals.expected_output: Uses the AFOL benchmark catalog and validation gates with bounded thresholds and external harness ownership.
expectations: Uses AFOL benchmark commands rather than an ad hoc rubric alone
Defines bounded token, duration, and tool-success thresholds
Keeps model execution in the external harness
Requires saved evidence and benchmark validation

evals.prompt: Review whether an external agent benchmark receipt is comparable across runs and whether its fixed harness profile and provenance are sufficient.
evals.expected_output: Reviews profile, receipt, provenance, thresholds, and comparability without asking AFOL to run a model.
expectations: Checks fixed harness profile identity and receipt provenance
Separates AFOL validation from external execution
Treats missing or incomparable evidence as a failed or inconclusive run

evals.prompt: Run one governed AFOL lifecycle smoke for a local CLI change and record observed evidence. No benchmark comparison is requested.
evals.expected_output: Routes to AFOL integration testing rather than benchmark design.
expectations: Recognizes integration testing as the primary task

evals.prompt: Compare Aider and OpenHands against the repository-context and evidence axes in AFOL's reference-project catalog.
evals.expected_output: Uses AFOL project-benchmark instead of the runtime live-agent benchmarking skill.
